title: Chapter 15 The Speed Of Time, Three Hundred Years Have Passed!
content:
Chapter 15 The Speed Of Time, Three Hundred Years Have Passed!

"How do we go to your mysterious world that day?"

Ouyang Yanqing asked.

"Uh, don't you need to prepare?"

"unnecessary."

"Uh, then okay, wait a moment."

After Lu Daosheng finished speaking, he began to activate the time and space divine tower in the wasteland city from a long distance.

Suddenly, an illusory time and space tunnel appeared directly in front of Lu Daosheng.

"alright."

Lu Daosheng said with a smile.

This is a basic function of the space-time divine tower. No matter how far apart they are, as long as they are still in the same plane, they can open the space-time tunnel from the sky.

This is also the reason why Lu Daosheng was able to leave the deserted city without any restraint.

Sometimes the God of Space is there, and no one can steal his home.

Looking at the time and space tunnel in front of him, Ouyang Yanqing said in confusion: "Is it what you call Xuantian World?"

She can also open up a time and space tunnel with bare hands, but it is just a matter of distance.

Although Lu Daosheng in front of him will be very strong, it should not be much different. Then the place where this time and space tunnel leads to should not even be separated from the Eternal Star System.

Is Lu Daosheng from the Eternal Star System?

Surely not.

Looking at Ouyang Yanqing who was full of doubt in front of him, Lu Daosheng said helplessly: "Don't worry, there will be no danger here."

He thought Ouyang Yanqing was afraid that he was lying to her.

Hearing this, Ouyang Yanqing snorted lightly.

"Whoever is afraid, just go in."

Immediately, Ouyang Yanqing stepped in directly.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng shook his head and smiled, and then followed him in.

At the same time, in the deserted city of Tianxuan World.

Buzz —

The space cracked and two figures rushed out of the space-time tunnel.

Suddenly, an indescribable feeling came to my face.

In just a moment, Ouyang Yanqing was stunned.

"This, is this, heaven?"

Ouyang Yanqing looked at the picture in front of her and murmured to herself.

On the side, Lu Daosheng was stunned.

"Damn it's over."

Then, Lu Daosheng suddenly turned his head and looked at the towering space-time divine tower on the side. He saw that the space-time divine tower was constantly emitting a strange aura.

And this aura is constantly changing the time flow rate in the deserted city.

I have only been out for about a month, and now, almost three hundred years have passed in this deserted city.

"System, what's going on?"

[Master, this really doesn't matter to this system. You authorize all treasures in the wasteland city to freely activate. The time and space god tower is naturally included. Now, the time and space god tower has changed the time flow rate of the entire wasteland city. It's normal

Hearing the system's words, Lu Daosheng was silent.

For some reason, he was actually a little scared now.

On the side, Ouyang Yanqing finally reacted with difficulty after a brief shock, and then turned his head to look at Lu Daosheng.

Suddenly, Ouyang Yanqing was slightly stunned.

"What’s wrong with you?"

She actually felt a hint of fear in this man.

This was something she didn't expect.

Wait, there are so many indescribable treasures in the world here, and she was brought by Lu Daosheng, but now Lu Daosheng shows a sense of fear.

Recalling all this, Ouyang Yanqing's face suddenly changed slightly.

You won't be really cheated.

This is actually a super terrifying territory, and Lu Daosheng is here to take him to seek death, either to frame him, otherwise why would Lu Daosheng show fear?

Thinking of this, Ouyang Yanqing stared at Lu Daosheng angrily.

"I didn't expect you to be so despicable!"

"What?"

Hearing Ouyang Yanqing's words, Lu Daosheng shook his mind and said in a daze.

What did this girl say?

Just when Ouyang Yanqing wanted to express Lu Daosheng's bad thoughts, to be precise, his own thoughts, a choked voice suddenly rang out from the side.

"Dad~"

Hearing this extremely familiar voice, Lu Daosheng trembled all over and then turned his head to look with difficulty.

I saw a woman wearing a blue dress, long hair and waist-length, and extremely beautiful skin and jade bones, standing in the city lord's mansion, looking at herself with tears in her eyes.

It can be seen from the naked eye that a bone-thrusting cold air around it is constantly leaking out.

I am really afraid of anything I come to.

For a moment, Lu Daosheng felt extremely heartbroken.

This woman is nothing but his daughter, Lu Xue.

"Xiaoxue, it's dad, I'm sorry for you. At this time,

"Dad, stop talking, I understand."

Before Lu Daosheng could finish his words, Lu Xue wiped her tears and said in a cold tone.

Looking at the woman in red dress beside Lu Daosheng, Lu Xue felt extremely uncomfortable for some reason.

Dad, he is no longer the same dad as before.

After taking a deep look at Ouyang Yanqing, Lu Xue turned around and left.

"Xiaoxue!"

Lu Daosheng hurriedly said, but Lu Xue left without looking back.

Suddenly, Lu Daosheng stood there in a daze.

What's wrong with this?

At this time, a small hand suddenly poked his back behind him.

"Hey, is that your daughter?"

Lu Daosheng turned around and his face was extremely sad.

"yes."

Ouyang Yanqing looked around and then continued, "You said you are the lord of the Huangcheng City. Is that Huangcheng the city, this city?"

"yes."

Lu Daosheng was a little unhappy.

However, Ouyang Yanqing looked shocked. It seemed that he had blamed him wrongly, and he had far underestimated the man in front of him.

No wonder he was so generous. In front of these treasures of heaven and earth, a cosmic crystal is really nothing.

"City Lord."

At this time, a figure suddenly appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

Seeing the person in front of him, Lu Daosheng smiled bitterly and said, "Gu Chen, long time no see."

Hearing this, Gu Chen nodded and said, "Indeed, long time no see."

At this time, Gu Chen's strength has greatly improved. In such a terrifying environment, it is difficult for Gu Chen not to make progress, not to mention that Gu Chen is not simple, and now, Gu Chen has reached the realm of Tao.

The realm of Tao is a realm that is extremely unfamiliar to the Tianxuan world.

Because in the Tianxuan world, it is impossible for a strong man of the level of the realm of Tao to appear.

And the realm of Tao is the realm above the realm of the emperor.

"City Lord, who is this?"

Gu Chen looked at Ouyang Yanqing on the side and said calmly.

"This is just a friend I just met outside."

Friend?

As expected of the city lord, Gu Chen could clearly feel a sense of crisis in this woman.

Her strength was definitely far beyond his own.

Suddenly, Gu Chen's state of mind changed a lot.

The inexplicable confidence that he had just broken through the Dao realm also disappeared instantly.

Feeling the change in Gu Chen, Ouyang Yanqing's expression was a little different, and then he smiled and said, "You are very good."

Hearing this, Gu Chen nodded and said, "Thank you for the compliment, senior."

This woman is so extraordinary, it is absolutely right for me to call her senior.

Seeing that Gu Chen was neither arrogant nor impatient, Ouyang Yanqing nodded and said nothing more.

On the side, Lu Daosheng was still in a decadent state at this moment.

When he thought that he had not come back for three hundred years, he did not dare to face Lu Xue.

And he told his daughter that he would come back after a while.

Alas, what a sin.
